Mysteek Naturals, LLC is a fiercely dynamic emerging veteran woman owned small business. The founder of Mysteek Naturals Electra S. Davis is believed to be one of the first women to have created a toxin free temporary hair color product – having started developing the product in 2016. Mysteek Naturals allows people to transform their day to day lives with products such as Coal White Activated Charcoal Toothpaste for white teeth and vibrant temporary hair colors without the fear of harmful substances such as developers, dyes, and bleach, fluoride, sulfates, artificial flavoring, baking soda, peroxide.

You will receive 15% of each order initially. Yet, you have the opportunity to reach higher tiers of commissions percentage in the overall sales minus the shipping cost when you obtain a certain dollar threshold.

Joining our program, you can expect to receive a personalized link and dashboard that’s user friendly for you to monitor your stats at your leisure. We will reward affiliates on the monthly bases for hitting high revenue milestones. We will also announce interim competitions for our affiliates to compete for unbelievable prizes. We want you to love this experience and have fun doing it.

Our influencers lead the way in bring awareness to the products we provide which are free of harsh chemicals. We require full participation on any special promotions or sales events we launch. You are free to repurpose content via Mysteek Naturals’ social medias and emails and or you are free to create your own content to ensure you are successfully in rising to the top as an affiliate so long as it does not go against the rules found in our Terms and Conditions. We are so honored that you have chosen to assist in spreading the message to world about our products!

Mysteek Naturals hopes to welcome you into our family. We hope that you have the same passion as we do in helping people utilize more healthier hair, body, and oral product alternatives.

For more information on our affiliate program, please visit our website mysteeknaturals.com or contact Affiliate@mysteeknaturals.com. If you agree to our Terms and Conditions that you read over via the hyper link below then you will receive further instructions after you hit the submit button.

Here are a Few Guidelines about Our Program:

 We pay loyal affiliates monthly via PayPal or for all commissions

earned.

 Please keep in mind that we only allow affiliates who use ethical marketing

practices (no spamming or offensive content).

 We do not pay commissions on self-purchases, so please do not use your own

affiliate link to buy products. All self-purchases will be voided.


We have new promotions all the time giving you LOTS of opportunities to spread the

word and earn commissions


Warmly,

Affiliate Manager


Here are a few Questions and Answers that may


assist you:


MYSTEEK COLOR POP


Q: Does it come off on your hands or stain them?

A: Mysteek Color Pop is cream based, so it is transferable, but it does not stain the

hands. We do recommend using gloves when applying.

Q: How many uses can you get from it?

A: The life of the product depends on your active lifestyle, the size container you

obtain, how much hair you have, and if you are touching your hair constantly.

Q: Would this work over previously colored hair?

A: Yes, but you may need to add a generous amount to cover the previous color since

this product is cream based.

Q: Can colors be mixed?

A: Most definitely, please mix the colors as you so choose.

Q: What are the benefits of using this product versus other permanent dyes or rinses?

A: This product is a Chemical Free, No Dye, Non-Permanent, No Developer, No Lift, No

bleach, Non-rinse, No pre lighten, Washable hair tint. You can add colors every day

without harm to the hair follicles.

Q: Is it Drying?

A: This product will not dry your hair out.

Q: Can I flat Iron My hair with this product?


A: It is not recommended as this product is wax based. It will change the consistency

of the product. However, one may flat iron the hair and then place the product onto the

hair once complete. **Note the color will not be as vibrant on straight hair.

Q: Does this product work on Locked Hair?

A: Yes, it does, however the customer should not shingle the product into the hair like

hair gel, rather they should pat the color onto the loc and not press the color into the

loc. Pat not press. A little goes a long way.

Q: How much would I need for my hair?

A: It depends on the look you are going for. For example, coloring just the tips, the

entire head, and how much hair the customer has.

Q: Does this product work on relaxed hair?

A: Yes, it does. However, this product does not show as bright on straight hair.

Q: Does this product grow out or wash out?

A: This product washes out in one wash session.

Q: Can I twist my hair at night with this product?

A: Yes, yet with other products you would need to reapply color in conjunction with the

twisting and oils. It is then recommended that the customer wear a bonnet to prevent

rubbing off the color onto pillows.

All hand made with love and care.

NOTE: Please mix color around in container before the first use to obtain

optimum color intensity.


COAL WHITE TOOTHPASTE


Q: How long does it last and how does it taste?

A: On average when using a dime size with a single user usage this product should last

1 month. Usage varies per household and person. We offer the toothpaste in the flavor

of peppermint.

Q: What is the difference in this toothpaste versus other non-all-natural brands?

A: Mysteek’s Coal White Toothpaste does not contain: Fluoride, SLS (Sodium Lauryl

Sulfate), Artificial Flavors / Colors, Artificial Sweeteners, Sodium laureth sulfate

(surfactant), Propylene Glycol, Triclosan, Sodium benzoate (synthetic preservative),


Potassium sorbate (synthetic preservative), Sodium hydrogen carbonate (Baking Soda),

or Hydrogen Peroxide.

Q: Does it stain your sink?

A: No, but like everything that involves oils we recommend the sink be cleaned after

each use to avoid product build up.
